<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917921_theRebbe_748" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917921_theRebbe_748__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the light, before revelation, is included in the luminary itself, and that within the potential to illuminate lies also the potential not to illuminate, both being one essence, which is the root of concealment and revelation in the revealed light.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, it is known</t>
    <t s="2">that the light</t>
    <t s="3">(before it was revealed)</t>
    <t s="4">was included in the very essence of the luminary.</t>
    <t s="5">However, while it is included in the luminary,</t>
    <t s="6">it is not in the category of light at all, but only that it has the potential to illuminate.</t>
    <t s="7">Based on this, it must be said</t>
    <t s="8">that the two levels mentioned above in the light that is in a state of revelation</t>
    <t s="9">(before the tzimtzum),</t>
    <t s="10">have their root also in the included light.</t>
    <t s="11">And the point of explanation in this is,</t>
    <t s="12">that this—that the Essence has the potential to illuminate—</t>
    <t s="13">is not a particular matter, heaven forbid,</t>
    <t s="14">(a source for light),</t>
    <t s="15">but rather,</t>
    <t s="16">this is that He, blessed be He, is all-powerful,</t>
    <t s="17">from which it is understood</t>
    <t s="18">that in the potential to illuminate</t>
    <t s="19">(as it is in the Essence)</t>
    <t s="20">there is also the potential not to illuminate.</t>
    <t s="21">And both of them</t>
    <t s="22">(this—that He has the potential to illuminate, and this—that He has the potential not to illuminate)</t>
    <t s="23">are one matter.</t>
    <t s="24">And since the light included in His Essence is this—that the Essence has the potential to illuminate</t>
    <t s="25">(as above),</t>
    <t s="26">and in this potential there is also the potential not to illuminate,</t>
    <t s="27">therefore,</t>
    <t s="28">also as the light is drawn forth in revelation,</t>
    <t s="29">it contains the two matters of concealment and revelation,</t>
    <t s="30">above relevance to worlds and relevance to worlds,</t>
    <t s="31">which are the root of Sovev and Memaleh after the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="32">from which are made the "upper" and "lower" of the worlds.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section discusses how the ultimate unification of "upper" and "lower" will occur in the days of Moshiach, rooted in the single potential of the Essence to both illuminate and not illuminate, as illustrated by the Midrash on "Who will give from Zion."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is "And the spirit of Havayah shall rest upon him," etc.</t>
    <t s="3">For it is known that the innovation of Moshiach is that through him the two matters of "upper" and "lower" will be unified.</t>
    <t s="4">And the beginning of the connection of "upper" and "lower" was at the time of the Splitting of the Red Sea,</t>
    <t s="5">except that then it was only temporary,</t>
    <t s="6">and this was a preparation for the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="7">"the upper ones descended below and the lower ones ascended above."</t>
    <t s="8">But the true connection of "upper" and "lower" will be in the days of Moshiach.</t>
    <t s="9">And as it is brought in the Midrash on Tehillim on the verse,</t>
    <t s="10">"Who will give from Zion," etc.,</t>
    <t s="11">"You find that two times it is written in the book of Tehillim 'Who will give from Zion,'</t>
    <t s="12">one in the first book,</t>
    <t s="13">and one in the second book.</t>
    <t s="14">The master said one and the student said one.</t>
    <t s="15">The master said, 'Who will give that their heart be this for them,'</t>
    <t s="16">and the student said, 'And who will give that all the people of Hashem were prophets.'</t>
    <t s="17">Neither the words of the master nor the words of the student are fulfilled in this world,</t>
    <t s="18">but in the World to Come both are fulfilled.</t>
    <t s="19">The words of the master, from where? It is said,</t>
    <t s="20">'And I will give you a new heart.'</t>
    <t s="21">The words of the student, from where? It is said,</t>
    <t s="22">'And it shall be after this, I will pour out My spirit upon all flesh.'</t>
    <t s="23">For this—that the heart of physical man will be to fear Me all the days—</t>
    <t s="24">is that the "lower" will connect with the "upper,"</t>
    <t s="25">and this—that 'I will pour out My spirit upon all flesh'—is that the "upper" will connect with the "lower."</t>
    <t s="26">And this—that in the Future the connection of "upper" and "lower" will be</t>
    <t s="27">[in both manners,</t>
    <t s="28">that the "lower" will ascend to the "upper" and that the "upper" will be drawn down to the "lower"]—</t>
    <t s="29">is because then both of them will be</t>
    <t s="30">(the "upper" and the "lower")</t>
    <t s="31">as they are from the aspect of the potential of the Essence,</t>
    <t s="32">which has the potential to illuminate and the potential not to illuminate.</t>
    <t s="33">And since the potential to illuminate and the potential not to illuminate are one matter</t>
    <t s="34">(as above, section 9),</t>
    <t s="35">therefore,</t>
    <t s="36">also the "upper" and "lower"</t>
    <t s="37">(when their first root is revealed in them,</t>
    <t s="38">as they are in the potential),</t>
    <t s="39">will connect and unify as one.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the "spirit of Havayah" is the light of Ein Sof as included in the Essence, and through its revelation in Moshiach, opposites like wisdom and understanding, counsel and might, knowledge and fear of Hashem, and even the external world, will be unified.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is "And the spirit of Havayah shall rest upon him,"</t>
    <t s="1">"Spirit" is the light of Ein Sof as it is included in the essence of the Luminary,</t>
    <t s="2">which is the potential of the Essence.</t>
    <t s="3">And through the revelation of the "spirit of Havayah" that will be in Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="4">there will be unification also in the particular matters.</t>
    <t s="5">And this is what the verse continues: "a spirit of wisdom and understanding, a spirit of counsel and might, a spirit of knowledge and fear of Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="6">for wisdom and understanding are two opposite matters,</t>
    <t s="7">and nevertheless they will be unified as one</t>
    <t s="8">[therefore they are included in one spirit,</t>
    <t s="9">"a spirit of wisdom and understanding"],</t>
    <t s="10">because in the wisdom and understanding of Moshiach it will be recognizably revealed that they are drawn from their root, the "spirit of Havayah"</t>
    <t s="11">(a spirit of wisdom and understanding),</t>
    <t s="12">and therefore they will be unified as one.</t>
    <t s="13">[And similarly regarding counsel and might,</t>
    <t s="14">knowledge and fear,</t>
    <t s="15">that despite being opposites,</t>
    <t s="16">they will be unified as one.]</t>
    <t s="17">And this is also the connection of "a spirit of wisdom and understanding" with "and he shall judge the poor with righteousness,"</t>
    <t s="18">even though the judgment of Moshiach will be by means of smell,</t>
    <t s="19">for "smell" is a makif,</t>
    <t s="20">because in Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="21">the makif</t>
    <t s="22">(smell)</t>
    <t s="23">and the pnimi</t>
    <t s="24">(wisdom and understanding)</t>
    <t s="25">will be unified as one.</t>
    <t s="26">And this is also what the verse continues,</t>
    <t s="27">"And the wolf shall dwell with the lamb," etc.,</t>
    <t s="28">that the connection of "upper" and "lower" will be not only in Moshiach himself,</t>
    <t s="29">but that through Moshiach there will be</t>
    <t s="30">(a parallel of)</t>
    <t s="31">this matter also in the entire world,</t>
    <t s="32">until "and the wolf shall dwell with the lamb," etc.,</t>
    <t s="33">and even in the category of the inanimate,</t>
    <t s="34">and as the verse continues,</t>
    <t s="35">"For the earth shall be filled with knowledge of Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="36">that even the physical earth</t>
    <t s="37">(inanimate)</t>
    <t s="38">will be filled with knowledge of Havayah,</t>
    <t s="39">with the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu, speedily and truly.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
